purpose: Measure bounded exact-arithmetic performance jointly over candidate products M and valuation thresholds T, under declared access and capacity profiles.
attempt_order: Three rounds over all cases. Round 1 base order main T ascending/M ascending/workload independent then correlated, then supplemental. Round 2 reverse base. Round 3 rotate base left by 7.
resource_failure_policy: Continue every remaining planned attempt after TIMEOUT or confirmed MEMORY_LIMIT; no family pruning, no retry or replacement.
validation_failure_policy: Stop the suite on INPUT_INVALID, RECONSTRUCTION_FAIL, SOLVER_ERROR, ENV_KILLED or LAUNCH_ERROR; retain diagnostics and mark all remaining rows NOT_RUN_SUITE_ERROR.
global_budget_policy: No internal suite wall limit. Each formal worker receives the full 300-second deadline plus at most 1 second cleanup. Do not launch under an external orchestration cap unable to reserve full remaining windows.
interrupt_policy: Keep finalized started attempts immutable; recover unfinished RUNNING reservations as INTERRUPTED. Resume only attempts with no durable launch reservation. Never replace an interruption with success under the same attempt ID.

metrics.primary_time: process_wall_seconds, includes interpreter/imports/loading/exact solve/internal recovery/external canonical validation/certificate write
metrics.memory: os.wait4 ru_maxrss measured in Linux KiB, report MiB; separate from 4-GiB address-space limit
metrics.completion: Exact completion requires worker success before deadline and exact recovery checks; report exact/planned and exact/started plus all status counts.
metrics.censored_time: TIMEOUT is right-censored at 300 seconds. Success requires first observed full return strictly before 300; never use timeout as a completed duration.
metrics.summaries: All 42 planned IDs remain in denominator. Counts by attempt status, input, environment segment, completion thresholds; successful-only median/min/max with success count; RSS by status. Historical R21 remains separate.
metrics.state_count: Returned S/F/Q/edge_value cache entries, including infeasible states, excluding tail cache; only for exact complete attempts.
metrics.bit_lengths: Maximum numerator/denominator bits for input rational values and returned numerical certificate fields. Not all internal DP states.
metrics.repeat_interpretation: Three fresh processes repeat the same deterministic input, measuring run variability rather than independent demand sampling.

inference_scope: Synthetic, declared arithmetic and input shapes; main grid holds B/K fixed. Supplemental profile changes B and K together and does not identify their separate effects. T changes support size and input bit lengths. No comparison to archived machine timings, no universal runtime bound or deployment-calibrated demand claim.
